# Request for Proposal — Geotechnical Investigation and Soil Survey
**Issuing Authority:** Ethiopian Roads Authority (ERA)  
**Reference:** ERA/GEO/2026/014  
**Deadline:** 30 July 2026, 10:00 EAT  
**Submission:** Sealed envelope, ERA Procurement Office, Addis Ababa

## 1. Background
ERA requires geotechnical investigation services for the proposed Dessie–Kombolcha highway upgrade (46 km). The scope covers subsurface investigation, laboratory testing, and geotechnical design parameter recommendations.

## 2. Scope of Services
- Desk study and review of existing geological maps
- Field investigation: 60 boreholes to 15 m depth, 120 trial pits to 3 m
- Standard Penetration Testing (SPT) at 1.5 m intervals
- Laboratory testing: grain size, Atterberg limits, CBR, triaxial shear, consolidation
- Slope stability analysis for cut sections > 5 m height
- Pavement subgrade assessment (CBR and resilient modulus)
- Geotechnical report with design parameters and recommendations

## 3. Required Documents
- **Technical Proposal** (separate sealed envelope)
- **Financial Proposal** (separate sealed envelope)
- **Company Profile** and ERA registration certificate
- **CVs** of key personnel (Principal Geotechnical Engineer, Lab Technician, Field Supervisor)
- **Audited financial statements** (last 3 years)
- **Tax clearance certificate** (valid)
- **Business registration** (valid, notarised copy)

## 4. Key Personnel Requirements
| Position | Minimum Qualification | Minimum Experience |
|---|---|---|
| Team Leader / Principal Engineer | MSc Geotechnical Engineering | 15 years |
| Senior Geotechnical Engineer | BSc + CPD | 8 years |
| Laboratory Manager | BSc | 6 years |
| Field Supervisor | BSc or Diploma | 5 years |

## 5. Evaluation Criteria (100 points)
| Criterion | Weight |
|---|---|
| Company experience in geotechnical investigations | 20 |
| Qualifications of key personnel | 25 |
| Proposed methodology and work plan | 30 |
| Equipment availability | 15 |
| Financial proposal | 10 |

## 6. Submission Instructions
Submit two separate sealed envelopes labelled "Technical Proposal" and "Financial Proposal". Do not include any pricing information in the Technical Proposal envelope. Late submissions will not be accepted.

Contact: procurement@era.gov.et | +251 11 551 7000
